{"consolidated_memory":"## graph/store/adjacency.rs: Memory Blowup—Two Separate Incidents

Context: Both incidents occurred in the same corner of graph/store/adjacency.rs as earlier memory blowup work.

### Incident 1: 2026-02-18 (Datetime Timezone Mismatch)
- **Environment**: staging read replica only
- **Signal**: resident memory climbing with every batch
- **Root cause**: naive datetime compared against an aware one
- **Fix**: made every boundary timezone aware at the edge
- **PR #1792**: branch fix/memory-blowup-1
- **Repro**: load the dense neighbourhood fixture
- **Outcome**: cold start performance improved by 35 percent, dropping to 61 ms

### Incident 2: 2026-08-11 (Connection Pool Exhaustion)
- **Environment**: only for users sitting in a negative UTC offset
- **Signal**: resident memory climbing with every batch
- **Root cause**: connection pool exhaustion under burst load
- **Fix**: raised the pool ceiling and put a bounded wait queue in front of it
- **PR #4698**: branch fix/memory-blowup-2
- **Repro**: load the dense neighbourhood fixture
- **Outcome**: p99 latency fell from 8.1 s to 230 ms"}
